task.title: Multi-persona sponsor resolution service (Pantheon scope)
task.summary_zh: Implements sponsor resolver per blueprint §11 MPO-001. Accepts N persona proposals from MGMT-SYN PersonaAllocationProposal store, detects conflicts via existing conflict classifier, produces sponsor-resolved proposal, requires sponsor persona, outputs conflict_resolution_log. Pantheon-scope only — does NOT re-implement MGMT-SYN allocation logic; consumes MGMT-SYN-005 output as input.
acceptance: Unit tests cover happy path and at least one fail-closed case
Reviewer signs off via ai-status.sh approve
Artifact exists in worktree at closeout

handoffs.message: PR #360 merged into dev at merge commit 088a5dd06784c4bd304e2dea40f5bb2e878637c7. Implementation commit b3603e97 adds governance multi_persona sponsor resolver, conflict_resolution_log model, and focused tests. Validation: tests/governance/test_sponsor_resolver.py plus adjacent MGMT-SYN classifier/synthesis/artifact tests all pass; GitHub Commit trailers, Runtime mirror guard, Smoke acceptance all pass. Please review/approve so owner can run done closeout.

Review failed: sponsor_resolver trusts source_conflict_resolution_log.committee_ref without validating that the source log matches the artifact/proposals. An unrelated source log can close open committee conflicts and be recorded as source_conflict_resolution_log_id. Please validate source log capital_pool_id, scope_ref, proposal_ids, sponsor_persona_id, synthesis_method/log linkage before committee_ref or source weights/veto data are accepted, and add regression coverage for mismatched source log fail-closed behavior.
PR #365 merged; source conflict log validation added with fail-closed regression coverage. Reviewer follow-up requested for MPO-001-V2.

Review blocked: sponsor_resolver classifies all source proposals as open even when MGMT-SYN source_conflict_resolution_log hard-vetoed a conflicting proposal. Repro: two high-conviction long/short proposals, pap-beta vetoed by PoolRiskPolicy(forbidden_strategy_families), MGMT-SYN emits single_proposal artifact, but resolve_sponsor still opens direction_conflict and sponsor_ambiguity. Required change: treat source vetoed_proposals as resolved/closed for open_conflicts, or classify only unresolved/surviving proposals for the live-binding gate, with regression coverage.
Source-veto regression fix merged in PR #367 (eb105a2cc33a59b3c509e2c4b1e51386317c8e63); pytest tests/governance/test_sponsor_resolver.py passed; ready for Codex2 review.
Review approved: source-veto regression fixed in PR #367; focused sponsor resolver and adjacent optimizer tests pass. Returning to Codex for owner closeout.
